quotes.text: Learn how to accept Klarna, a global buy now, pay later payment method.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: Before you start the integration, make sure your account is eligible for Klarna
When the customer chooses to pay Klarna with a deferred payment option (pay later, installments, and financing), Klarna collects enough information for risk assessment and approval.
An authorized Klarna payment must be captured within 28 days of the authorization
We recommend that you [rely on webhooks](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-intents/verifying-status.md#webhooks) to confirm the status of a payment.

findings: The complete 2026-11-07 raw is a 19-line variant index: Checkout, Elements, Direct API, and mobile iOS/Android/React Native routes only (new raw lines 9-19). It does not itself restate integration instructions, eligibility, SDK support, errors, manual capture, testing values, or payment outcomes. The diff replaces the older full text with this index (content.diff lines 1-18 and 3658-3664); no behavioral deprecation or new behavior is established.

The 2026-05-06 old capture (despite its 2025 filename) covers Checkout Session hosted/embedded modes and Elements Session mode (old raw lines 18-73 and 436-466), mobile PaymentIntent plus client-secret and webview confirmation (old raw lines 830-989, 1500-1657, 2167-2317), and a separate Direct API PaymentIntent/Stripe.js path (old raw lines 2827-3014). The current source summary lines 11-23 is broadly on-topic but omits the React Native variant and these object and state boundaries; line 13 incorrectly places PaymentIntents inside the Elements variant rather than Direct API/mobile scope.

A pre-existing summary error is material: source line 17 says billing prefill is via payment_method_options.klarna, but the old guide's Klarna form prefill example uses payment_method_data.billing_details and payment_method_data.klarna.dob (old raw lines 3602-3645); its Direct API advice likewise names payment_method_data.billing_details (old raw lines 2835-2843). The same unsupported field path appears in wiki/concepts/stripe-bnpl.md line 227. This is a baseline accuracy issue, not a change proved by the new index.

Current source line 19 states manual capture support without the old guide's consequential 28-day capture deadline, automatic cancellation after expiry, requires_capture state after authorization, and explicit capture request (old raw lines 3453-3476). Source line 21's 23-country data and 3500 tip must remain May-capture and context qualified; old raw lines 75-81, 414-418, 3063-3067 and 3400-3404 distinguish sandbox data from the separate production-testing amount sentence.

Old Direct API describes a client-secret handoff, Stripe.js confirmKlarnaPayment and return_url (old raw lines 2888-2988), with return parameters used to query a PaymentIntent (old raw lines 3003-3014). Manual redirect can leave requires_action/redirect_to_url and recommends webhook verification (old raw lines 3508-3588); return or client callback alone is not authoritative success. Old failed-payment states include PaymentMethod detachment and requires_payment_method after decline or 48-hour inaction (old raw lines 3422-3447).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Preserve the May 6, 2026 guide's account-eligibility precheck and Checkout recommendation as dated, path-specific guidance (old raw lines 8-12); the November index only points to variants (new raw lines 9-19).

Preserve the May-capture per-country test tables and sandbox/email/2FA/repayment context as historical, not a current eligibility matrix or live success guarantee (old raw lines 75-81, 83-412, 416-434, 2319-2323).
Preserve the May-capture optional manual capture terms, including 28-day cancellation and requires_capture, with date and PaymentIntent scope (old raw lines 3453-3476).
Preserve Direct API's old API-version-qualified failure-code warning: before 2023-08-16, Klarna errors were reported as payment_intent_authentication_failure (old raw lines 3436-3447).

Preserve older SDK examples as dated: Android sample pins 23.7.0 (old raw lines 1521-1546), iOS guide says iOS 13+ for its then-described SDK (old raw lines 851-853), and Direct API sample loads dahlia Stripe.js (old raw lines 2963-2986). The new index does not revalidate any of these versions.
conflicts: Current source line 17 and wiki/concepts/stripe-bnpl.md line 227 use payment_method_options.klarna for prefill; old raw lines 3602-3645 and 2835-2843 support payment_method_data.billing_details instead. A correction should identify the Direct API/example scope and avoid claiming all UI paths accept the same fields.

Current source line 13 places PaymentIntents under Elements, whereas that old variant creates an Elements Checkout Session (old raw lines 436-466) and the separate Direct API/mobile variants use PaymentIntents (old raw lines 925-947, 2243-2265, 2827-2843).
unresolved_questions: Detailed November variant contents were not captured in the pinned new raw. Their linked URLs are navigation only; current behavior, eligibility, SDK versions, and updated testing or capture rules remain unverified.

findings: Source lines 11-23 need a dated November variant-index provenance route while retaining the May detailed raw route; line 13 should include React Native and distinguish Elements Checkout Sessions from Direct API/mobile PaymentIntents (old raw lines 436-466, 925-947, 2827-2843). Source line 17's prefill field path is unsupported by old raw lines 2835-2843 and 3602-3645. Source line 19 omits the 28-day manual-capture limit and requires_capture state from old raw lines 3453-3476. Source line 23 should bound client handler result versus webhook-confirmed completion (old raw lines 964-989 and 3580-3588).
conflicts: Existing prefill field attribution and Elements/PaymentIntent grouping conflict with the old guide; new raw lines 9-19 are only variant navigation and cannot resolve or renew detailed May claims.
source_assessments.reason: The new capture is navigation-only, but a reviewable source correction is needed for accurate provenance and material pre-existing summary claims.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/klarna/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture identifies a Klarna acceptance guide and routes readers to Checkout, Elements, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native variants; it establishes no detailed payment behavior or prerequisites (new raw lines 5-19). The May 6, 2026 capture instead checks Klarna account eligibility, shows Checkout Sessions for hosted/embedded and Elements paths, and uses server-created PaymentIntents with client secrets for native and Direct API confirmation (old raw lines 8-73, 925-966, 2243-2265, 2827-2988). Its redirects, requires_action/requires_payment_method/requires_capture and succeeded event are distinct states, so a return is not proof of payment (old raw lines 3422-3428, 3453-3476, 3531-3588). source-stripe-klarna-accept-payment.md summarizes several paths but omits React Native and misattributes prefill at lines 13-23; its historical details remain dated rather than refreshed by the index.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/klarna/accept-a-payment, the observed raw delta is presentation and navigation: the November file is a variant index with six routes and no substantive instructions (new raw lines 9-19), while the diff removes the detailed May text from this unparameterized capture (old raw lines 8-12, 2827-2843, 3453-3588). Nothing here proves that Klarna behavior, eligibility, manual capture, errors or SDK versions changed. source-stripe-klarna-accept-payment.md should keep the older raw with May dating, add November index provenance, correct its unsupported payment_method_options.klarna prefill attribution using the older Direct API and example evidence, and qualify the 28-day capture rule and client result versus webhook status. Its iOS, Android, React Native, Checkout, Elements and Direct API guidance has separate client/server and UI scope; old API-version and sandbox testing qualifications must not become current guarantees.
